custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location, with a hyphen in its part number and Min 1 and Max 5.
  • Make sure no other Part Library entry has a number that matches part A's, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces.
  • Have a parts import file with one row whose part number is part A's number in lower case with periods in place of its hyphens, with part A's description, Min 3 and Max 7.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; the page is titled Inventory Import Preview).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839427-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839427-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • The inventory import page has Download Template (a file with the right columns), Select CSV File (to pick your file) and Submit File.
custom_steps:
1. Click Select CSV File and pick the file.
  2. Click Submit File.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes and does not refuse the row, although its number differs from part A's in case and punctuation.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Still exactly one row: part A, under its own part number, unchanged, now with Min 3 and Max 7.
  • No second part was added.

Step 6:

  • No row for part A's number is listed on the Inactive tab either.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S7-N7: “S7-N3 to S7-N6 do not apply to the parts CSV import. An import row whose number matches a part already stocked at this location updates that part (S13-N9a). It is never refused for a duplicate number.”
  • S13-N9a: “When an import row's number matches a Part Library entry that is already stocked as a part at this location, the import updates that part. It never adds a second part on the same entry. A match ignores upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces, so re-importing an old number that differs from the new one only in those ways updates the renamed part.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of scope: “How the parts CSV import matches a part number to a Part Library entry. The import matches a number ignoring upper and lower case. If nothing matches, it also ignores hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. It writes the row's description onto the entry it matches. It never moves a part to a different entry and never changes an entry's part number (S13-N9).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
